exclusions.reason: Original Spelunkery slots move/consume tablet and paper, create codex/paper, set tutorial flag, native crafted hooks, sounds and container cleanup. Nuclear Furnace Menu/ResultSlot retain original recipe access, output transfer, onCraftedBy, used-recipe XP and original firePlayerSmeltedEvent; hazard is the actual furnace tick already canonical, not result pickup. No status/damage/healing callback. Original external item/event behavior is retained, not declared absent.

CaveBook use passes native stat/consume trigger, swing and client GUI, returns PASS. CaveInfo/tablet/codex CUSTOM_DATA biome metadata and CaveBookProgress unlock state are ordinary acquisition/readers. CaveMap inventoryTick periodically rechecks filled-map biome and schedules native biome worker/UpdateItemTagMessage, not a force, status or target. Worker reads biome/noise, fills original map colors and releases search tickets; commands have permission2 and locate-biome output only. Native player/world map context is not progression or attack ownership.

Native template placement settings for Licowitch/Gingerbread/Cabin/Soda pieces explicitly ignore entities; markers configure loot or remove marker blocks only. UndergroundRuins/Forlorn/Whalefall retain ordinary template placement and processors. Exact eight pinned configs select58 template names:57 available NBT payloads contain zero entities; one exact missing entry is separately proven. Ordinary containers/decorative NBT remain utility; original AbyssalAltar/magnet state and native hazard blocks are independently represented. No owner/team/attack is fabricated from template metadata. DonutArch methods withdrawn from the graph actually write native Voronoi distance/offset, generator cache and mutable block positions while placing dough/frosting/sprinkles; they are terrain geometry, not read-only accessors.

Exact deferred registrations/codecs, original config default/bounds setup, material tag/POI state sets, biome/noise/map initialization and reset preserve native definitions and environment/search admission. Runtime combat consumers are independently canonical; definition field assignment is not an extra effect or scalar. Feature/surface/carver bodies create terrain/fluids and original block hazards, never extra damage requests. Keybind/cape/sound/creative/pot/loot/acquisition registrations are excluded as ordinary presentation/utility. This judgment uses exact native constructors/calls/fields, not keyword absence or names.
